content.short: OMNIA is a decentralized node provider delivering secure, private, and scalable blockchain infrastructure.
content.description: Originally launched in 2021 by co-founders Chrsitian and Alexandru Lupascu, OMNIA provides decentralized node infrastructure and management for blockchain users and developers. Through the Omnia Protocol, anyone can create an RPC Node with a simple app and communicate directly with the blockchain. Node operators can earn rewards when Omnia privacy relayers forward requests to their RPC. The protocol currently supports node management on the Bitcoin, Ethereum and Binance Smart Chain networks.
